operation: Dump regions, geometry batches, collision, lighting, quality switches and runtime handles with explicit units.
required_evidence: source line range per architecture entity
collider data or a not_captured marker
steps: Root the scene and record background, fog, camera, lights and any unit statement.
Describe regions, batching and collision from the code that creates them.
Record quality switches separately from lighting and reflections.
Search LOD, streaming and instancing; record a scoped not_observed rather than an absolute absence.
acceptance_checks: Units remain not_specified when the source does not state them.
Uncaptured collider and instance counts are labeled, not estimated.
Four explicitly created lights are not turned into a screenshot-based estimate.

on_failure.retry: Resolve the specific unresolved reference or line range, then re-run the check.
on_failure.stop: Stop when the scene cannot be rooted without guessing or a traversal would require unauthorized access.
